entries.rationale: HonoWarden operator health and root surfaces are not official-client protocol routes.
Official clients read a self-hosted billing stub; this is not cloud commerce activation.
Private allowlisted bootstrap is a HonoWarden operator surface.
Official Azure Event Grid file-validation is a hosted storage callback, not a self-hosted protocol requirement.
Official custom grant is pinned; HonoWarden does not accept webauthn grants yet.
Pinned clients do not require this server capability for the alpha personal vault.
Duo is a hosted identity integration, not a self-hosted protocol requirement.
Account lifecycle can verify email behind a default-off flag; config remains false.
Official web-push is optional; HonoWarden uses SignalR-compatible notification hubs instead.
Sync includes an empty sends array; this is not Send runtime support.
Staging may advertise premium profile state for attachment/TOTP compatibility. It does not enable Sends.
Key Connector is an optional hosted identity integration.
SCIM is an enterprise directory integration, not personal-vault protocol.
SSO is out of alpha scope.
Admin console UI is upstream hosted operations, not the API-only Worker.
Organization administration beyond owner collection CRUD remains planned.
Account protocol family is implemented with default-off writers.
Login-with-device auth requests are implemented.
Emergency Access remains rejected.
TOTP account-login family is implemented.
Passkey login remains planned.
Cloud billing, seats, and sponsorships are hosted-only.
Config reads are implemented.
Device protocol family is implemented.
Official info controllers are not part of the client protocol matrix.
Organization license and sponsorship APIs are hosted licensing.
Domain settings are implemented.
HIBP, reports, and chat integrations are the P2 decision slice.
User-key rotation is implemented behind a default-off flag.
Notification center is not in the alpha personal-vault matrix.
Installations, push vendors, and SSO cookies are hosted platform services.
Secrets Manager is a separate product line.
Official clients can import locally; server import is not required for personal vault sync.
Organization export is not a personal-vault claim.
Send remains 501 until HON-186 activation.
Personal cipher routes are implemented.
Folder routes are implemented.
Security tasks belong to the reports decision slice.
Sync is implemented.
Payment webhooks are hosted commerce.
Organization event collection is not an alpha personal-vault claim.
Icon proxy is an explicit non-goal.
Identity accounts, prelogin, and info family.
Identity billing is hosted commerce.
SSO remains out of scope.
Notification hubs are implemented.
Official seeder API is development-only and is not a client protocol surface.
HonoWarden is API-only; a Web Vault requires a new ADR before any support claim.
Weak and reused password checks in the pinned extension are local; exposed-password range lookups call an external API from the client.
